instance.description: The instance to create the database on.

name.description: A unique identifier for the database, which cannot be changed after the instance is created. Values are of the form [a-z][-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9].

version_retention_period.description: The retention period for the database. The retention period must be between 1 hour and 7 days, and can be specified in days, hours, minutes, or seconds.

ddl.description: An optional list of DDL statements to run inside the newly created database. Statements can create tables, indexes, etc.

deletion_protection.description: Whether or not to allow Terraform to destroy the instance. Unless this field is set to false in Terraform state, a terraform destroy or terraform apply that would delete the instance will fail.
deletion_protection.rationale: Enabling deletion protection prevents accidental or unauthorised destruction of the Cloud Spanner database, protecting critical data from being permanently lost.

enable_drop_protection.description: Whether drop protection is enabled for this database. Defaults to false. Drop protection is different from Terraform's prevent_destroy.
enable_drop_protection.rationale: Enabling drop protection prevents accidental or unauthorised dropping of the Cloud Spanner database, protecting critical data from being permanently lost.

encryption_config.description: Encryption configuration for the database. Structure is documented below.

kms_key_name.description: Fully qualified name of the KMS key to use to encrypt this database.

database_dialect.description: The dialect of the Cloud Spanner Database. Possible values are: GOOGLE_STANDARD_SQL, POSTGRESQL.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
